subtopics.name: Legal and Political Developments
subtopics.description: Explore the latest legal rulings, government statements, and political debates surrounding the TikTok ban.

tasks.description: Compile recent legal documents and court rulings related to the TikTok ban.
Summarize statements from key political figures and government agencies.
Analyze the potential long-term political implications of the ban.

subtopics.description: Investigate how different countries are reacting to the TikTok ban and their own policies regarding the app.

tasks.description: Gather data on countries that have implemented similar bans or restrictions.
